en: \[VSCode] Fixed custom skills and custom slash commands sent from the VS Code or JetBrains panel leaving out the open file or selected lines that ordinary messages include (anthropics/claude-code#102799)
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了从 VS Code 或 JetBrains 面板发送的自定义 skills 和自定义斜杠命令遗漏普通消息所包含的打开文件或选中行的问题（anthropics/claude-code#102799）
